experiment: E8 Faddeev-Skyrme Hopf solitons (Model C), SEED.md sec. 4 and 6C; preregistered in PLAN.md sec. 4 E8

conventions.energy: E = 1/(32 sqrt2 pi^2) Int [ d_i phi.d_i phi + 1/2 (d_i phi x d_j phi)^2 ] d^3x (Sutcliffe 2007); Ward conjecture E >= Q^{3/4}; proven E >= (3/16)^{3/8} Q^{3/4}
conventions.lattice: forward-difference links (sigma term) + 4-corner plaquette average (Skyrme term), exact discrete gradient, field fixed to e3 on the boundary of [-L,L]^3
conventions.hopf: Q = -(1/16 pi^2) Int A.B, B_i = 1/2 eps_ijk phi.(d_j phi x d_k phi) from plaquette solid angles, curl A = B by FFT (Coulomb gauge); sign chosen so that Sutcliffe's ansatz W = Z1^n/Z0^m has Q = +nm
conventions.curves: position curve phi = -e3; linking curve phi = (sqrt(2mu-mu^2),0,-1+mu), mu = 0.1; tube phi3 < -0.8

units: energies in units of 32 sqrt(2) pi^2 x (sigma-model coupling); dimensionless as in Sutcliffe 2007
target_source: Sutcliffe 2007 (arXiv:0705.1468), Table 2: dx = 0.1, 151^3 grid, fixed boundary; absolute energies about 1% low, relative energies about 0.1%
tolerances: E_Q within 2% of the table (Q=1-4 required), E_Q/E_1 within 1%, type match, |Q - integer| <= 0.05

verdicts.claim: SEED sec. 4: E/Q^{3/4} stays near 1.2, so the energy per unit charge falls and bigger folds store charge more cheaply
verdicts.evidence: E/Q^{3/4} = 1.185-1.245 at dx = 0.1 and 1.19-1.25 in the same-box continuum; E/Q falls monotonically; every E_Q is 10-19% below its cheapest split. Energies are those of the solutions reached from one start per charge (upper bounds on the minima; they match Sutcliffe's survey).

verdicts.claim: E_2 < 2 E_1: a charge-2 fold does not split
verdicts.evidence: E_2/(2E_1) = 0.8149 at dx = 0.1, 0.8166 in infinite volume (axial code); cross-check spectral 0.8166

verdicts.claim: SEED sec. 4/6C: Q = 7 is a trefoil
verdicts.verdict: CONFIRMED as a reproduction of the literature minimum (trefoil-type minimum reached from the preregistered trefoil start; global minimality not re-searched here: one start per charge, so it rests on Sutcliffe's survey)
verdicts.evidence: one position loop with Alexander polynomial t^2-t+1 (3 projections, dx = 0.15 and 0.1), Q_link = 7, E_7/E_1 = 4.3645 vs 4.3538

verdicts.claim: SEED sec. 4: E >= c|Q|^{3/4}; the 3/4 power is the right one and the computed minima agree (Sutcliffe 2007)
verdicts.evidence: all energies above Q^{3/4} and 0.534 Q^{3/4}; fitted exponent 0.764 over Q <= 7 (Sutcliffe's table 0.763), consistent with but not a test of the asymptotic 3/4; optimality is Lin & Yang 2004 (PLAN 3.1)

verdicts.claim: SEED sec. 4/6C: the lowest folds are rings and each charge's minimum is a definite knot or link
verdicts.verdict: CONFIRMED as a reproduction of the literature types (one start per charge; that these are the global minima rests on Sutcliffe's survey)
verdicts.evidence: A11, A21, bent A~31, A22, L^{1,1}_{1,2}, L^{1,1}_{2,2}, K32, all as in Sutcliffe Table 2

1_absolute_energy_convention.resolution: CALIBRATED holds for the same-grid comparison (dx = 0.1; +1.25% to +1.80%). Against the same-box continuum (ours, confirmed by the cross-check's 4th-order energies to -0.02%/+0.07%) Sutcliffe's table is 1.7-2.2% low, outside 2% for Q = 1, 4, 5, 7; against the infinite-volume continuum for Q = 1 it is 1.7% low. The robust parts of the calibration are the ratios (<= 0.3%) and the types.

3_E1_literature.context: PLAN 1.21-1.22 is summary-grade; Sutcliffe 2007: "around 1.21" from several authors; Ward 1999 (hep-th/9811176) quotes axial 1.25 K0 (Gladikowski-Hellmund) and 3D 1.13 K0 (Battye-Sutcliffe 1998, called a finite-volume underestimate); K0 = 1 in these units
